audit_status.source_base: Greek Revelation text tradition with Ezekiel little-scroll imagery; draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for mighty messenger, seven thunders sealed, no more delay, little scroll eaten sweet/bitter.

verses.restored: And I saw another strong messenger descending from heaven, clothed with cloud, rainbow upon head, face like sun, feet like pillars of fire.

familiar.text: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:

verses.restored: He had in hand a little scroll opened, and set his right foot on sea and left on earth.

familiar.text: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,

verses.restored: He cried with great voice as lion roars; when he cried, the seven thunders spoke their voices.

familiar.text: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.

verses.restored: When the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write, and I heard voice from heaven saying: Seal what the seven thunders spoke, and do not write these things.

familiar.text: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.

verses.restored: The messenger whom I saw standing on sea and earth raised his right hand to heaven,

familiar.text: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,

verses.restored: and swore by the One living into ages of ages, who created heaven and things in it, earth and things in it, sea and things in it, that delay will be no longer,

familiar.text: And sware by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:

verses.restored: but in days of voice of seventh messenger, whenever he is about to trumpet, the mystery of the Divine is completed, as he good-newsed to his servants the prophets.

familiar.text: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.

verses.restored: The voice that I heard from heaven again spoke with me, saying: Go, take the opened scroll in hand of messenger standing on sea and earth.

familiar.text: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.

verses.restored: I went to the messenger, saying to him to give me the little scroll. And he says: Take and eat it; it will make your belly bitter, but in your mouth it will be sweet like honey.

familiar.text: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.

verses.restored: I took the little scroll from the messenger's hand and ate it; in my mouth it was sweet like honey, and when I ate it, my belly was made bitter.

familiar.text: And I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.

verses.restored: And they say to me: It is necessary for you again to prophesy concerning many peoples and nations and tongues and kings.

familiar.text: And he said unto me, Thou must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.

translation_notes: Little scroll echoes Ezekiel: prophetic word is sweet to receive and bitter to embody.
Seven thunders are sealed; not all revelation is disclosed.
No more delay concerns completion of Divine mystery, not prediction arithmetic.
safety_note: Do not speculate on sealed thunders or use the little-scroll scene for esoteric certainty; the text itself withholds content.
